claim: For every prime p, every characteristic-p field k, and every compact Lie group G with non-p-nilpotent component group, the canonical k-cellularization map Gamma_k R -> R is zero on all homotopy groups for R=C_*(Omega((BG)^p_completed);k).
scope: No adjoint orientability, nilpotent action or spectral-sequence-collapse assumption is used.
mechanism: Proxy-smallness gives filtered approximations with finite-dimensional total homotopy; R-linear images are finite-dimensional graded ideals in an infinite-dimensional graded Hopf algebra; such ideals vanish.
prior_results: Dwyer-Greenlees-Iyengar compact proxy and Morita theorems; section5.7 loop-chain proxy-smallness for compact Lie groups
Sweedler finite one-sided ideal theorem, with primary verification in Lomp section2.4
Ishiguro2007 Proposition1.3(a), BG p-compact implies component group p-nilpotent
originating_question_credit: J. P. C. Greenlees, Oberwolfach Report 9/2026, Question 2.2, printed page 594.
